hook.tease: Now your team can start with ==the same plugins==

new.headline: Share plugins with *your team.*
new.summary: Maintainers pick approved Agent Plugins as team defaults on github.com.

setup.headline: Set up a *team default.*
steps: As a maintainer or owner, open your team on github.com and select **Customize Copilot**.
Browse marketplace plugins and add the approved ones to the team.
Direct members get them in VS Code, GitHub Copilot app and CLI; child teams don’t.
setup.note: Policies still win; members can turn plugins off.

try.headline: Try this *prompt.*
try.prompt:
List the Agent Plugins enabled in this session.

For each one, say whether it looks like a team default or something I added myself, and what in the session tells you.

Only report what you can see. Don’t install, remove or change any plugin.

check.question: Wait, but does everyone on the team get it?
check.headline: Team default. *Not everyone.*
check.takeaway: **Check who actually has it.** Direct members get defaults, child teams don’t, and members or policy can switch plugins off.
